name: Arcane Training
description:
You have spent your time studying magic to compete with those who have magical gifts.
Learn two level 2 Arcane Feats.
Your proficiency level in Arcana increases (max Expert).
unlockedFeats: Arcane Feat - Level 2, Arcane Feat - Level 2

name: Attunement
description:
You have an attunement, a magical connection through your soul to one aspect of magic.
This makes it easier to cast that type of magic, but prevents you from casting the opposite aspect.
Spells from your attuned aspect are called attuned spells.
-While casting attuned spells, reduce their mana cost by their rank.
-While casting attuned spells, you may also use your WIL instead of INT for the spellshaping check.
-You cannot learn or cast spells of the opposite aspect from your attunement.
Get the Basic Elemental Magic arcane feat for your attuned aspect.

name: Crafting Prodigy
description:
You are specialized in one field of crafting above everything else and are able to craft things that would normally be above your level of knowledge.
You learn one of the Armor Artificer, Artificer's Weapon or Runegun Smith feats, ignoring their level requirements.
When picking new feats you treat feats from your chosen archetype as if their level requirements were 2 levels lower.
Additionally, your proficiency level in Crafting increases (max Expert) and have a +3 bonus to any checks regarding your field.

name: Experienced
description:
You've spent your time doing a variety of things. 
Gain one more background and one level 1 General Feat.

name: Large Mana Well
description:
You have a larger than average mana well, allowing you to cast more spells and increasing the strength of your aura. 
Increase your maximum mana by your WIL.
Every time you level up your maximum mana increases by 2 more.

name: Remnant Connection
description:
You have a rare and mysterious connection to the Remnant, an ancient civilization which left ruins all of Kastorix, which helps you in small ways.
Once per day you may choose to reroll a failed roll; you must keep the new one even if it's worse.
Certain artifacts and creatures may treat you differently.

name: Soulsight
description:
You possess the rare gift of natural soulsight, allowing you to see souls. Souls appear as tiny dots of light in the center of living creatures.
You have soulsight as an imprecise sense up to 10 tiles.
You have the Inspect Soul action.
You may spend a focus point to use it as a free action.

name: Swift
description:
Few can match your incredible speed.
You have 1 tile extra movement speed and may add your DEX again to initiative checks.
Your proficiency level in Reflex saves increases one step (max Expert).

name: Tough
description:
You're tougher than most.
Increase your maximum health by 3 + your PHY.
Twice per day when you reduce your exhaustion you may also restore your health equal to your PHY.
Your proficiency level in Fortitude saves increases one step (max Expert).

name: Voidchild
description:
Marked by the void, feared by the living.
You ignore the Complex trait on spells with the Void trait.
You learn 1 + your INT or WIL apprentice spells of your choosing.
You have a +3 bonus on saves against effects with the Void or Soul traits.
You have low-light vision.
Void Children have starry purple eyes and faintly glowing skin.
NOTE: Void Children are outlawed in the Draconium and some other countries and will be hunted on sight.

name: Danger Sense
description:
You have an unnatural sense for incoming danger.
Your proficiency level in Reflex saves increases one step (max Master).
While off-guard you reduce the penalty by two.

name: Force of Personality
description:
Your willpower can increase the strength of your spells.
Your proficiency level in Persuasion and Intimidation increases one step (max Master).
You may use WIL for Intimidation checks.
When you cast spells you may spend mana equal to their rank to increase their initial DCs by that much.

name: Golemcrafter
description:
You have created a golem companion that follows you around.
Your proficiency level in Golem Lore and Crafting increases (max Expert).
See the golem companion page for more information.
If it is reduced to 0 hit points it is disabled and can be repaired with an hour's work at a workbench.
Once per turn, when you or your Golem takes an action, the other one can take one as a free action.

name: Magical Genius
description:
You have an innate aptitude for learning magic.
You learn extra spells of all ranks you know equal to your INT. 
You also learn Metamagics equal to your INT.
You have the Copy Cast action.

name: Nimble as a Fox
description:
Few can catch you.
Once per turn you may spend a focus point to take one of the Step, Stand Up, Hide, Take Cover, Tumble Through or Steal actions as a free action.
Your proficiency level in Reflex saves increases one step (max Master).

name: Physical Might
description:
Your strength makes you an imposing threat on the battlefield.
You add half your PHY again on weapon damage rolls, or if the weapon is two handed you add your full PHY again instead.
Your proficiency level in Athletics or Brawling increases one step (max Master).

name: Protective Aura
description:
Your aura absorbs more of the energy of incoming attacks.
While your aura has above half health, you can Aura Block without using your reaction.

name: Reactive
description:
Your reaction speed is faster than others.
You have two reactions per round.
You can only use one reaction for each creature's turn.

name: Soulbond
description:
You are soulbonded with a magical creature, giving you a direct connection to it.
The creature you can soulbond with depends on your level, as more powerful creatures require stronger magical power.
See the soulbonding page for more information.
You can only have one soulbond at a time, and if your soulbond dies you take 2d6 vital damage.

name: Faster Than The Eye
description:
You're so fast your movements can't even be perceived by some.
Your move speed increases by 1.
If your move speed + 5 is higher than a creature's passive Perception, they can't see you move and can't use reactions against your move actions.

name: Mana Blooded
description:
Exposure to magic has made your very blood infused with mana.
You have a +1 bonus to all spellshaping checks if you lost health since the end of your last turn.
Increase your health by 3 + your WIL.

name: Brutal Critical
description:
You strike with the fury of ancient berserkers.
While attacking, a roll of 19 also counts as a critical success (improves the degree of success).

name: Darkvision
description:
Whether with magic, training or artifice, you can now see in darkness as clear as light.
You have Darkvision, allowing you to see in darkness.
Your proficiency level in Perception increases one step (max Legendary).

name: Legendary Gadgetsmith
description:
You make gadgets as you breathe.
When you make gadgets, you always make them upgraded at no cost.
You can make two extra gadgets.
Your proficiency level in crafting increases one step (max Legendary).

name: Elementalization
description:
The connection to your aspect is so strong you have now become partly elemental in nature.
Gain a bonus depending on your aspect.
You require 10 mana per hour.
You learn all the apprentice and adept spells connected to your aspect.
You gain the elemental trait.

name: Unyielding Focus
description:
You always keep your mind clear and focused in battle.
At the start of each turn you regain one focus point.
You have advantage on saves with the Mental trait.
